// 1. O(n) linear scan using shared compareAsc()
function linearFind(arr, target) {
  for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    if (compareAsc(arr[i], target) === 0) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

// 2. O(n log n) bottom-up merge sort using shared compareAsc()
function mergeSort(input) {
  var arr = input.slice();
  var n = arr.length;
  var aux = new Array(n);
  for (var width = 1; width < n; width *= 2) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i += 2 * width) {
      var left = i;
      var mid = Math.min(i + width, n);
      var right = Math.min(i + 2 * width, n);
      var l = left, r = mid, k = left;
      while (l < mid && r < right) {
        aux[k++] = compareAsc(arr[l], arr[r]) <= 0 ? arr[l++] : arr[r++];
      }
      while (l < mid) aux[k++] = arr[l++];
      while (r < right) aux[k++] = arr[r++];
      for (var c = left; c < right; c++) arr[c] = aux[c];
    }
  }
  return arr;
}

// 3. O(n) two-pointer pair accumulation using shared hashValue()
function twoPointerDigest(sorted) {
  var lo = 0, hi = sorted.length - 1, acc = 0;
  while (lo < hi) {
    acc = (acc + hashValue(sorted[lo++] + sorted[hi--])) | 0;
  }
  return acc;
}

var manuallySorted = mergeSort(sharedData);
var total = checksum(manuallySorted) ^ twoPointerDigest(manuallySorted);
for (var k = 0; k < targetKeys.length; k++) {
  total += linearFind(sharedData, targetKeys[k]);
}
sink = total;
